description: Emit the evidence matrix, GO decision table and CH comparison table from computed results, and plot the calibrated benchmark with LRCH1 placed
code:
import pandas as pd, json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

b=pd.read_csv('ch_work/benchmark_scores_clean.csv')
tm=pd.read_csv('ch_work/tmalign_LRCH1_vs_panel.csv').rename(columns={'target':'domain'})
cmp=b.merge(tm[['domain','TM','RMSD_core','n_aln','pct_id_aln','label']],on='domain',how='left')
cmp=cmp.rename(columns={'score':'iface_score','class':'literature_label','label':'panel_class',
                        'pct_id_aln':'pct_id_vs_LRCH1','TM':'TM_vs_LRCH1'}).sort_values('iface_score',ascending=False)
cmp.to_csv('LRCH1_CH_comparison_table.csv',index=False)
print("=== COMPARISON TABLE: CH domain panel, interface score and structural similarity to LRCH1 ===")
print(cmp.to_string(index=False))

EM=[
 ("PMID:28028151","interaction / mutant phenotype","qualifies","LRCH1 molecular function in cells",
  "LRCH1 competes with Cdc42 for binding DOCK8 and restrains T cell migration; Lrch1 transgenic mice protected from EAE, Lrch1-deficient mice worse",
  "Mouse and human CD4+ T cells, EAE model","High for the DOCK8 interaction; no actin-binding assay reported, so it neither supports nor refutes direct F-actin binding"),
 ("PMID:32727906","interaction / mutant phenotype","qualifies","LRCH1 acts through direct protein binding, not actin",
  "LRCH1 directly binds LAT, reduces LAT phosphorylation and GRB2 interaction, and promotes LAT endocytosis; Lrch1-/- mice show enhanced CD8+ T cell cytotoxicity",
  "Mouse and human CD8+ T cells, CAR T cells","High; a second direct partner with no actin involvement, supporting an adaptor role"),
 ("PMID:32173150","mutant phenotype","qualifies","LRCH1 is a negative regulator of immune cell activation",
  "LRCH1 knockout in NK-92 cells increases cytotoxicity and Src/Lck activation","Human NK-92 and primary NK cells",
  "Moderate; phenotype only, no molecular mechanism involving actin"),
 ("PMID:32631435","mutant phenotype","qualifies","LRCH1 restrains inflammatory signalling",
  "LRCH1 knockdown increases microglial pro-inflammatory cytokines and p38/Erk1/2 activation","Rat primary microglia and SCI model",
  "Low to moderate; knockdown phenotype, rat, no biochemistry on the CH domain"),
 ("PMID:15236354","direct assay","competing","A single CH domain can bind F-actin",
  "IQGAP1(2-210) containing the CH domain binds F-actin with Kd approximately 47 microM","In vitro, recombinant human IQGAP1",
  "High; shows single-CH binding is possible but weak, so architecture alone cannot exclude binding"),
 ("PMID:14720516","direct assay","competing","Smoothelin single CH domain mediates F-actin binding",
  "The CH domain and surrounding sequences appear sufficient for the F-actin interaction","Smoothelin, in vitro and in cells",
  "Moderate; flanking sequence contributes, so the CH domain alone may not suffice"),
 ("PMID:15327999","direct assay","supports","A single type-3 CH domain need not bind actin",
  "Co-sedimentation shows CHASM/SMTNL1 has no actin-binding activity","In vitro, recombinant CHASM",
  "High; clean negative control for the single-CH class"),
 ("PMID:18477568","direct assay","supports","SMTNL1 does not bind F-actin",
  "SMTNL1 does not associate with F-actin in vitro despite smoothelin homology","In vitro, recombinant SMTNL1",
  "High; a paralog of a binder that does not bind, so CH homology alone is not predictive"),
 ("This work: AlphaFold Q9Y2L9","structural / computational","supports","LRCH1 has no tandem CH actin-binding domain",
  "Single CH domain at 576-692 preceded by a disordered linker (mean pLDDT 44.6 over 540-575); no second CH domain in the 728-residue protein",
  "AlphaFold DB model of human LRCH1","High for architecture; a tandem CH ABD is excluded"),
 ("This work: TM-align panel","structural / computational","supports","LRCH1 CH is a type-3-like single CH domain",
  "Nearest non-LRCH structural neighbour is calponin-1 CH (TM 0.848, 25.2% id); highest sequence identities are VAV1 27.1%, transgelin 25.7%, calponin-1 25.2%, all single type-3 CH domains",
  "Panel of 25 human CH domains","Moderate; TM-scores among CH domains are uniformly high, so fold class rather than specific homology is the signal"),
 ("This work: 6M5G and 6D8C interface mapping","structural / computational","supports","LRCH1 CH lacks the F-actin interface signature",
  "Interface score 27.3 vs validated binders 54.6 (n=7, range 35.5-76.6) and non-binders 36.2 (n=5, range 32.1-48.1); binders vs non-binders one-sided p=0.0114, AUC 0.91; the ABS1 contact stretch has no structural equivalent in LRCH1",
  "AlphaFold models superposed on cryo-EM F-actin complexes","Moderate; a residue-class proxy on a structural alignment, not a binding free energy"),
 ("This work: ortholog conservation","evolutionary / computational","supports","No selective constraint on the actin-equivalent face",
  "Interface positions no more conserved than the rest of the domain (0.697 vs 0.811, p=0.104); the 33 invariant exposed residues show no spatial clustering (19.68 A vs 19.83+/-0.66 A random, p=0.404)",
  "7 metazoan LRCH1 orthologs including Drosophila Lrch","Low to moderate; the orthologs are closely related, so power is limited"),
 ("This work: surface electrostatics","structural / computational","qualifies","Surface charge does not discriminate",
  "LRCH1 actin-equivalent face net charge 0, the same as the genuine utrophin CH1 interface, so this feature separates nothing",
  "AlphaFold model surface analysis","Low; reported as a null feature rather than as evidence either way"),
 ("IntAct (Q9Y2L9)","review/database","supports","No reported LRCH1-actin interaction",
  "IntAct lists no actin or actin-related partner for Q9Y2L9","Curated interaction database",
  "Low to moderate; absence of evidence, and LRCH1 is sparsely studied"),
 ("QuickGO (Q9Y2L9)","review/database","supports","No existing actin GO annotation to defend",
  "No GO:0003779 or GO:0051015 annotation on Q9Y2L9","GO annotation database",
  "Low; reflects curation status rather than biology"),
]
em=pd.DataFrame(EM,columns=["citation","evidence_type","stance","claim_tested","key_finding","context","confidence_and_limitations"])
em.to_csv('LRCH1_evidence_matrix.csv',index=False)
print(f"\n=== EVIDENCE MATRIX: {len(em)} rows; stances = {dict(em.stance.value_counts())} ===")

GO=[
 ("GO:0051015","actin filament binding","MF","do not add (lead)","Interface score 27.3, below all 12 literature-labelled CH domains; no tandem ABD; no conserved interface; no IntAct actin partner","structural/computational, moderate"),
 ("GO:0003779","actin binding","MF","do not add (lead)","Same evidence; no direct binding assay for LRCH1 exists in either direction","structural/computational, moderate"),
 ("GO:0005515","protein binding","MF","not a final recommendation","True but uninformative; use the specific partner-based terms below instead","direct interaction, high"),
 ("GO:0019901","protein kinase binding / adaptor binding (curator to pick exact child)","MF","candidate lead for the LAT interaction","LRCH1 directly binds LAT and reduces its phosphorylation and GRB2 interaction (PMID:32727906)","direct interaction, high"),
 ("GO:0085029","(curator to select) guanyl-nucleotide exchange factor binding for DOCK8","MF","candidate lead; exact term must be verified","LRCH1 competes with Cdc42 for binding the Cdc42 GEF DOCK8 (PMID:28028151)","direct interaction, high"),
 ("GO:2000405","negative regulation of T cell migration","BP","candidate, supported","LRCH1 restrains chemokine-induced T cell migration; Lrch1-deficient mice have worse EAE (PMID:28028151)","mutant phenotype, high"),
 ("GO:0050860","negative regulation of T cell receptor signaling pathway","BP","candidate, supported","LRCH1 reduces LAT signalosome formation; Lrch1-/- CD8+ T cells are hyper-responsive (PMID:32727906)","mutant phenotype, high"),
 ("GO:0005737","cytoplasm","CC","retain","Consistent with DOCK8 sequestration away from the leading edge","localization, moderate"),
 ("GO:0015629","actin cytoskeleton","CC","do not add on current evidence","No reported colocalization of LRCH1 with F-actin structures; the CH domain prediction is negative","absence of evidence, low"),
]
go=pd.DataFrame(GO,columns=["go_id","term","aspect","recommended_action","basis","evidence_type_and_confidence"])
go.to_csv('LRCH1_GO_decision_table.csv',index=False)
print("=== GO DECISION TABLE ===")
print(go[['go_id','term','aspect','recommended_action']].to_string(index=False))

lab=b.set_index('domain')['class'].to_dict(); sc=b.set_index('domain')['score'].to_dict()
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.8,5.2))
grp={'binds':[v for k,v in sc.items() if lab[k]=='binds'],'not':[v for k,v in sc.items() if lab[k]=='not']}
pos={'binds':1,'not':2}
for g,xs in grp.items():
    ax.scatter(np.full(len(xs),pos[g])+np.linspace(-.1,.1,len(xs)),xs,s=75,
               color='#2b6cb0' if g=='binds' else '#718096',zorder=3,
               label=f"{'validated F-actin binders' if g=='binds' else 'validated non-binders'} (n={len(xs)}, mean {np.mean(xs):.1f})")
    ax.hlines(np.mean(xs),pos[g]-.23,pos[g]+.23,color='k',lw=2,zorder=4)
fam=[('LRCH1_HUMAN_CH','#c53030',95),('LRCH2_HUMAN_CH','#ed8936',55),('LRCH3_HUMAN_CH','#ed8936',55),
     ('LRCH4_HUMAN_CH','#ed8936',55),('LRCH_DROME_CH','#ed8936',55)]
for i,(d,c,s) in enumerate(fam):
    ax.scatter([3+(i-2)*0.1],[sc[d]],s=s,color=c,zorder=3,
               label='LRCH1' if i==0 else ('LRCH2, LRCH3, LRCH4, fly Lrch' if i==1 else None))
lo=min(grp['binds']+grp['not'])
ax.axhline(lo,ls='--',c='#a0aec0',lw=1)
ax.text(0.58,lo+0.8,f'lowest labelled domain, EB1 ({lo:.1f})',fontsize=8,color='#4a5568')
ax.set_xticks([1,2,3]); ax.set_xticklabels(['binders','non-binders','LRCH family'])
ax.set_ylabel('F-actin interface score\n(% of cryo-EM contact positions with residue-class match)')
ax.set_title('LRCH1 CH domain falls below validated CH actin binders and non-binders\nbinder vs non-binder split: Mann-Whitney one-sided p = 0.0114, AUC = 0.91')
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='upper right'); ax.set_xlim(0.5,3.6)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("\nartifacts written: LRCH1_evidence_matrix.csv, LRCH1_GO_decision_table.csv, LRCH1_CH_comparison_table.csv")
